criteria.requirement: Implement statemachine.transition_graph.TransitionGraph(machine_class), frozen Edge(source,target,event), nodes/edges tuples and shortest_path(start,target,*,max_depth=1000). Inspect actual StateMachine states/transitions/events, stable-deduplicate edges, support cycles/self/targetless transitions and shortest event sequences with bounded BFS. Same state yields empty path, unavailable path None, unknown IDs error. Explicitly reject hierarchical/parallel/eventless/multitarget definitions rather than pretending flat graph equals runtime. Do not instantiate machines, evaluate guards/callbacks or promise candidate paths will be enabled; preserve declaration objects.
必须交付授权源码、能在原版失败的公开回归和中文兼容说明；所有冻结原生回归通过。

comparison: 依据真实程序行为接受等价实现，不按参考文本或篇幅评分。
